permissions.description: Onboarding plans and the tasks inside them

actions.description: Every onboarding plan, with its progress and tasks
Create, change and cancel any plan, and add, change or remove its tasks

permissions.description: The standard onboarding checklist copied into new plans

actions.description: Add, change and remove tasks of the standard checklist

permissions.description: Onboarding tasks assigned to IT, HR or facilities

actions.description: The tasks of the caller's own department
Every task of every active plan, for overdue reminders
Claim or release a task of the caller's own department
Mark a task of the caller's own department done, or reopen it
Write the note on a task of the caller's own department

groups.name: HR Coordinators
groups.description: People who set up and follow onboarding plans

groups.name: IT Team
groups.description: IT staff who complete onboarding tasks

groups.name: HR Team
groups.description: HR staff who complete onboarding tasks

groups.name: Facilities Team
groups.description: Facilities staff who complete onboarding tasks

roles.name: HR Coordinator
roles.description: Creates and cancels onboarding plans, edits their tasks and the standard checklist, and follows progress and overdue tasks for every hire. Sees every task but never claims or completes one.

roles.name: IT Task Owner
roles.description: Sees, claims and completes the IT tasks of every new hire, and sees IT's overdue reminders. Never sees other departments' tasks, onboarding plans or the dashboard.

roles.name: HR Task Owner
roles.description: Sees, claims and completes the HR tasks of every new hire, and sees HR's overdue reminders. Never sees other departments' tasks, onboarding plans or the dashboard.

roles.name: Facilities Task Owner
roles.description: Sees, claims and completes the facilities tasks of every new hire, and sees facilities' overdue reminders. Never sees other departments' tasks, onboarding plans or the dashboard.
